ns2:course.label: Infectious Disease in Livestock Systems
ns2:course.description: This is an 8-week graduate level course that covers the components and determinants of a healthy livestock system. The course will allow students to understand the interaction between animals (hosts), microorganisms (infectious disease) and the environment. The instructors assume that enrolled students have a foundational knowledge of pathogens and livestock system design and operations. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: DVM or equivalent. Restricted to graduate students only.
